name: After § 70
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2023
part_text: 70a. Calls on the Commission to invite opposition members of Parliament and experts with no links to the Commission to take part in its various ethics committees and anti-fraud procedures to strengthen the monitoring system; notes the predominant presence of EU staff and former members of the political coalition of the President of the European Commission within the European Anti-fraud office and the ECA;
